versions.name: Fingerprinting
versions.description: Roll a clean set of prints on a card or lift them with tape, sort the patterns into loops, whorls, and arches, and compare how police databases and biometric access systems use them.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
